t76gmn7r.baseName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit And Decorated Flocked Pop-Up Christmas Tree
t76gmn7r.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit And Decorated Flocked Pop-Up Christmas Tree
t76gmn7r.sourceDescription: Create a beautifully finished Christmas display without spending hours assembling, lighting and decorating your tree. The 6ft Pre-lit & Decorated Flocked Pop-up Tree combines snowy foliage, warm white lights and traditional decorations in one clever, easy-to-use design. The rich green foliage is covered with a generous layer of snow-effect flocking, creating the appearance of a freshly snow-covered Christmas tree. It's already decorated with a coordinated selection of red and white baubles and traditional tartan bows, giving you a classic festive look straight out of the box. With 150 warm white LED lights already arranged throughout the foliage, the tree produces a soft and welcoming Christmas glow. The LEDs are static and remain steadily illuminated, beautifully complementing the traditional decorations and snowy finish. Its clever pop-up construction makes setting up your Christmas display quick and straightforward, while the slim 65cm maximum width provides the presence of a 6ft Christmas tree without requiring the floor space of a conventional full-width design. At 6ft tall, it's a fantastic choice for living rooms, hallways, offices and other spaces where you want an impressive, complete Christmas display with a fraction of the usual decorating effort. Product Features • 6ft pre-lit and decorated pop-up Christmas tree • Snow-flocked green foliage • Pre-decorated with red and white baubles • Traditional tartan bows • Pre-lit with 150 warm white LED lights • Static / steady-on illumination • Slim 65cm maximum width • Quick and convenient pop-up design • 55cm diameter plastic stand • Ideal for spaces where a slim Christmas tree is preferred • 10 year branch and foliage guarantee • 1 year electrical guarantee • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

jv3kx48k.sourceDescription: This beautiful artificial hinged Christmas tree is very lifelike in its shape and appearance and is meant to create just the right atmosphere for this Christmas. Hinged construction: The Christmas tree has a hinged construction, so the branches will automatically fold down at the right angle. This will make it much easier to put up the tree in the perfect shape and will save you time as well.Sturdy stand: The iron stand provides your artificial Christmas tree with optimal sturdiness and stability.Flocked snow design: The Christmas ornament has artificial white snow on it, giving an attractive snow-flocked look.Economical choice: You can reuse the holiday ornament every year, which is a cost-effective option compared to getting a real tree. Good to know:We recommend setting aside 45-60 minutes after assembly to properly shape the tree by peeling back the branches and pulling the tips apart to give the branches a more full-bodied look. Product Specifications Tree colour: Green and white Material: PVC (polyvinylchloride), iron Total height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 90 cm Stand size: 45 x 17 cm (W x H) Hinged construction With 694 PVC tips Decorated with flocked snow Suitable for sheltered areas such as roofs, balconies, canopies, etc. Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Artificial hinged Christmas tree 1 x Stand • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
